name: Volcanic Ash
summary: Volcanic Ash gathers near lava in the Burning Steppes. Mux Manascrambler needs it to build a filter for his ectoplasmic distiller.

sections.title: Ash by the Lava
sections.body: Lava pools and dried channels in the Burning Steppes leave Volcanic Ash on the ground. Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan needs twenty-five handfuls for a filter in his ectoplasmic distiller. He is gathering several costly materials for the device, which he hopes will harvest the fabric of death.

faq.q: Where can I find Volcanic Ash?
faq.answer: Volcanic Ash lies near lava pools and dried lava channels in the Burning Steppes, mostly between Blackrock Mountain and Flame Crest.

faq.q: What is Volcanic Ash used for?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler needs Volcanic Ash to build a filter for his ectoplasmic distiller.
Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan needs twenty-five Volcanic Ash for his ectoplasmic distiller.

angles.text: Mux Manascrambler is building an ectoplasmic distiller and needs Volcanic Ash for its filter, alongside a Delicate Arcanite Converter.
